verdict.rationale: Godot is fully open source under the MIT license with no royalties or strings attached, and the repo points to official compilation instructions for every supported platform, so users can build and run the engine entirely on their own machines. A runtime probe confirms a keyless one-command install of a binary that runs `godot --headless` for CI, exports and scripted automation, and the docs cover headless operation on GPU-less servers. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of building from source.
